ratings.comment: Great class and a fun professor

We started the class using a free trial of an interactive textbook that Professor Gill gave us. In the middle of the class with no warning, the trial expired and every student had to pay $130 to continue doing homework for this class. That is inexcusable.

The class itself is not very interesting and you learn very little.

Doctor Gill is seriously a gem, I've taken 2 classes (215 and 370) with him and wish I could take more. He does expect a lot from his students in 370 compared to 215, so be aware of that, but he has faith that you can get it done! Unfortunately Socrative quizzes make their return (study vector math!) but they're not too bad. Always take Dr. Gill!

Professor Gill is the most incredible professor that I've ever had. He gives amazing lectures and makes sure everyone understands the course materials. There are 3 projects and 3 exams, you get a 1-page cheat sheet. and multiple phases for your project.  I would suggest you not procrastinate on your projects and study old exams for the new exams.

One of the things I appreciated about Dr. Gill is his emphasis on building bonds within the class. I've never had a class where the professor establishes a discord channel. I felt supported through out my time here, and during difficult stretches, I felt confident in my ability to master the material, both with his help and the help of my peers.

Ignore the salty 1 star review, they clearly didn't bother showing up to class. Dr. Gill is an amazing professor and cares DEEPLY about his students' success, gives MULTIPLE opportunities to make up work and is EXTREMELY knowledgeable. The CS department is better off with Dr. Gill in it, I will be seeking him out for all future classes.

(CS215) Youll be bacially teaching yourself. He has high expectations from you, comprehension and workload, while producing low expectations for himself.  Prepare to be left in the dark. The class would be actually fun if it was taught to learn.
ratings.ratingTags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

ratings.comment: Gurman Gill is an amazing professor and human in general. I took his class last semester as one of the only females, and it's hard (like every cs class), but he explains things very well during class and office hours, and makes it possible for all learning types to succeed. He records his lectures and posts them to look back at for students.

Tough class and he expected a lot from us. As soon as you finish one assignment there are already one or two others waiting for you to get started on. I recommend taking his class in a lighter load semester if possible. However, he is cool and I really like him as a person. Just sometimes I couldn't help feeling disappointed because the GRIND!

Would have gotten a higher grade if not for skipping a project. Make sure you do all projects and study for the tests because they are the biggest part of your grade. Class is not mandatory but very recommended he does notice who comes and talks. Towards the end of the semester, he will offer extra credit.

He was very focused on keeping students engaged and checked in a lot to make sure the class was following the material. I took this class spring '20 when it switched to online, and he did great with quickly reformatting the class to online. Knows a lot about game design and programming if that is something you're interested in.
Amazing teacher. Knows his subject matter very well and clearly works hard to implement best practices for actual teaching.

Very prepared, and uses multiple modalities in attempt to reach all learning types. Very accessible, and has SI's accessible most days of the week for help. Tough, but fair grader. Many small assignments, so you stay involved in this class each week.
ratings.ratingTags: Participation matters--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Clear grading criteria

ratings.comment: Dr. Gill is by far my favorite professor at SSU. Has a fantastic knowledge of Computer Science and its constructs. He understands that CS has difficult concepts, and works to make sure ALL students understand. If you attend class, do all homework/participation, and study on the regular you will get a good grade. Will look for him in future classes.
ratings.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

ratings.comment: Skip class? You won't pass. Gurman is fantastic, some discrete math concepts were hard to understand at first but the understanding came with the homework. I disliked zybooks initially, but looking back I guess it forced me to learn it (Homework/Participation)

Dr Gill is excellent at explaining things, his lectures were clear and well organized. Computer Science by nature is a difficult subject, but he handled the class well. He's also a patient, kind and funny guy. I hope to have his classes again!
ratings.ratingTags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

ratings.comment: Incredible lectures. Wish every teacher was able to replicate his lecture style. Every class starts with a review question from the class before, and then gradually proceeds into the new material. Super funny as well, cannot wait to have him again in future courses.
ratings.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--Amazing lectures

ratings.comment: Lectures are imperative. There are no surprises on the tests and he gives previous exams as study guides. He randomly calls on people during lecture, but even if you don't know, he will guide you through it. It's challenging material but with enough dedication anyone can get it. Reading was supplemental for me. Be prepared to spend hours in the lab
ratings.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria

ratings.comment: One of the best professors here at SSU. Took him my first year and I am taking him again for another class. I am honestly excited because he turned me onto CS.

He is very easy to talk to and truly wants each student to pass his course. Each lecture, he stops and makes sure people understand the material. He likes calling on people and "test" them on the material. It's intimidating but very helpful when you're called on and truly lost. He doesn't move on unless you get a clear understanding.

Dr. Gill really enjoys his subject and really enjoys teaching it! I have never taken a programming class before, and I was able to pick up on everything very quickly! Do as he says, and practice, and do the online readings!

His lectures are short but he is clear and to the point. His class is easy to follow and he starts from the basics and works his way up. You have the whole class for the tests and they are open-note. No homework in the lecture or the lab. Would definitely take again.

Fun guy. Loved his class. Lectures get repetitive because he loves reviewing, and he really prepares you for a test. While attendance isn't taken, it really helps for the labs and tests. Fun guy too, hope to have him again.
